title: Minimum Window Substring
description:
Given two strings `s` and `t`, return the **shortest substring of `s`** that contains every character of `t`, counting duplicates (if `t` has two `B`s, the window needs at least two `B`s).

If no such substring exists, return `""`. If several windows share the minimum length, return the **leftmost** one.
constraints: s and t consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters.
hints: Count how many of each character you still need, using a map built from t.
Expand the right edge until the window is valid, then shrink the left edge as far as it stays valid, recording the best window.
